description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans task scheduler, including classes like OrleansTaskSchedulerBasicTests and a supporting mock implementation UnitTestSchedulingContext. It verifies task scheduling, execution order, context propagation, and thread safety features of the Orleans scheduler.

classes.name: UnitTestSchedulingContext
classes.description: A mock implementation of IGrainContext for testing the Orleans task scheduler without requiring full grain activation.

classes.name: OrleansTaskSchedulerBasicTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests verifying core operations of the Orleans task scheduler, including scheduling, execution order, context preservation, and thread safety.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a UnitTestSchedulingContext with a specified ILoggerFactory.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up the test environment, primarily resetting the synchronization context.

methods.name: Async_Task_Start_ActivationTaskScheduler
methods.description: Test verifying that a scheduled task executes correctly on the scheduler.

methods.name: Sched_SimpleFifoTest
methods.description: Test checking that queued actions are executed in FIFO order.

methods.name: Sched_Task_TplFifoTest
methods.description: Test verifying that queued tasks execute in proper order and produce expected final state.

methods.name: Sched_Task_ClosureWorkItem_Wait
methods.description: Test with multiple tasks and manual reset events to verify proper task execution and synchronization.

methods.name: Sched_Task_TaskWorkItem_CurrentScheduler
methods.description: Test that tasks recognize the correct current scheduler context during execution.

methods.name: Sched_Task_SubTaskExecutionSequencing
methods.description: Test ensuring that multiple nested sub-tasks execute serially and complete as expected.

methods.name: Sched_AC_RequestContext_StartNew_ContinueWith
methods.description: Test validating context propagation across nested started tasks and continuations.

methods.name: RequestContextProtectedInQueuedTasksTest
methods.description: Test confirming that RequestContext values are protected across queued tasks, including asynchronous work.

methods.name: AsyncCheckClearRequestContext
methods.description: Helper to verify that request context is cleared during async work.

methods.name: NonAsyncCheckClearRequestContext
methods.description: Helper to verify request context clearing during non-async work.

methods.name: LogContext
methods.description: Utility for detailed logging of current thread and scheduler context during tests.

methods.name: InitSchedulerLogging
methods.description: Initializes the logging system with filters for scheduler-related diagnostics.
